faq.question: Q1. What is DMHO Bhadradri Kothagudem Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment notification for 3 vacancies of Medical Officer and Supporting Staff posts on a contract and outsourcing basis in Basti Dawakhanas of Bhadradri Kothagudem District.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in DMHO Bhadradri Kothagudem Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies notified under advertisement number Rc.No.E1/3196-MO/2026.

faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled for 15 October 2026, with registration and certificate verification from 10:30 A.M. to 05:00 P.M.

faq.question: Q4. What is the venue for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The venue is the Office of the District Medical & Health Officer, Bhadradri Kothagudem.

faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MBBS Degree registered with the Telangana State Medical Council.
